newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume jumps as prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume jumps as prices ease.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange surged to 1,888 kilos on Thursday, from 537 previously, as prices fell in line with the European market, dealers said.
"Demand from the free market firmed because of the lower prices ahead of the weekend," one said. "But most of the trade was made up of banks' arbitrage deals in dollar-lira currencies."
Gold closed at $342.50 an ounce and 1,588,600 lira per gram, down from Wednesday's $343.80 and 1,591,000 lira.
The Turkish currency closed at 144,070 against the dollar, versus a previous 143,550. That cushioned the drop in gold's lira price.
Almost all the day's trade -- 1,538 kilos -- took place in the morning session, with 70 percent in lira terms.
